input.summary: Add numbered Section 7.7 giving the Issuer (as customer) a 30-day convenience termination with pro rata refund of prepaid fees, and conform Section 8.3.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added Section 7.7 so that we, as the customer for the Servicer's services, may terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice with a pro rata refund of any prepaid fees, since the Agreement otherwise runs until the last Receivable is paid with only a for-cause removal right. We conformed Section 8.3 so the termination formula reads together with the new exit; Section 7.1's no-resignation bar on the Servicer is untouched.

ops.text: Section 7.7 Termination for Convenience. The Issuer, as the customer for the Servicer's services, may terminate this Agreement and the Servicer's rights and obligations under this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the Servicer, in which case the Servicer will refund pro rata any fees prepaid for the period after the effective date of the termination.
